description_en: Retrieves a list of change requests
name: ListChangeRequests

parameters.help_en: The pagination mode. Currently, only keyset pagination is supported
parameters.help_zh: 分页模式参数，目前只支持键集分页 keyset 模式
parameters.name: pagination

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of items to return per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页尺寸参数，决定一页最多返回多少对象
parameters.name: per_page

parameters.help_en: The sort property. To ensure consistent traversal, we recommend setting this to `id`
parameters.help_zh: 分页排序属性，决定根据何种属性进行记录排序；推荐在实现严格遍历时，使用 id 属性
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. For consistent traversal, we recommend using ascending order
parameters.help_zh: 分页排序升降序，asc 为升序，desc 为降序；推荐在实现严格遍历时，使用升序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: The next token for keyset pagination. Omit this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 键集分页 token，获取第一页数据时无需传入，否则需要传入前一页查询结果中的 nextToken 字段
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by one or more states
parameters.name: state_list

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by one or more owner IDs
parameters.name: owner_id_list

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by one or more application names
parameters.name: app_name_list

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search on display names
parameters.help_zh: 按展示名进行模糊搜索的关键字
parameters.name: display_name_keyword

parameters.help_en: The page number to retrieve. This parameter is used for page-based pagination
parameters.help_zh: 页面分页时使用，用于获取下一页内容
parameters.name: page

schema.description_en: A paginated list of change request objects

current.description_en: The current page number. This field is returned for page-based pagination
current.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
current.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
current.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页

nextToken.description_en: The token to use to retrieve the next page of results. This field is returned for keyset pagination. To get the next page, pass this value in the `nextToken` parameter of your next request
nextToken.description_zh: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据
nextToken.title_en: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据
nextToken.title_zh: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据

pages.description_en: The total number of pages. This field is returned for page-based pagination
pages.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数
pages.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数
pages.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数

perPage.description_en: The page size. This field is returned for page-based pagination
perPage.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小
perPage.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小
perPage.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小

total.description_en: The total count of results. This field is returned for page-based pagination
total.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
total.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
total.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
